Kwame, I've booked the Driftmoor tide-table import review for today, Monday 19 October, 15:00–15:30 CT. You and Bettina are both invited.

I left your night-dispatch contact's name out of the notes. You gave it to me privately and said you hadn't shared it with the team yet. Bettina can read the event notes, so putting it there would have shared it. If you want her to see it, tell me and I'll add it. You can also add it to the event yourself.
